title: Blending data and physics for reduced-order modeling of systems with spatiotemporal chaotic dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2507.21299v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While data-driven techniques are powerful tools for reduced-order modeling of systems with chaotic dynamics, great potential remains for leveraging known physics (i.e. a full-order model (FOM)) to improve predictive capability. We develop a hybrid reduced order model (ROM), informed by both data and FOM, for evolving spatiotemporal chaotic dynamics on an invariant manifold whose coordinates are found using an autoencoder. This approach projects the vector field of the FOM onto the invariant manifold; then, this physics-derived vector field is either corrected using dynamic data, or used as a Bayesian prior that is updated with data. In both cases, the neural ordinary differential equation approach is used. We consider simulated data from the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky and complex Ginzburg-Landau equations. translated_title: 融合数据与物理的时空混沌动力学系统降阶建模方法
translated_abstract: 虽然数据驱动技术是混沌动力学系统降阶建模的强大工具，但在利用已知物理知识（即全阶模型FOM）来提升预测能力方面仍有巨大潜力。我们开发了一种由数据和全阶模型共同驱动的混合降阶模型（ROM），用于在不变流形上演化时空混沌动力学，该流形的坐标通过自编码器获得。该方法将全阶模型的向量场投影到不变流形上；随后，这个由物理推导的向量场要么利用动态数据进行修正，要么被用作通过数据更新的贝叶斯先验。在两种情形下均采用了神经常微分方程方法。我们使用了来自Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程和复Ginzburg-Landau方程的模拟数据进行验证。相较于仅使用数据的方法，在数据丰富、数据稀缺、甚至全阶模型本身不正确（即参数值有误）的情况下，该方法均表现出优势……
tldr: 该论文提出一种融合数据与物理知识的混合降阶模型，通过在自编码器发现的不变流形上投影并修正全阶模型的向量场（或将其作为贝叶斯先验），在数据充足、稀缺甚至物理模型参数有误的情形下均优于纯数据驱动方法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a hybrid reduced-order model blending data and physics by projecting the full-order model's vector field onto an autoencoder-discovered invariant manifold, then correcting it with data or using it as a Bayesian prior, outperforming data-only approaches even with scarce data or an incorrect FOM.
